audit.whatIsWrong: The entire matchup is built on a Pantheon passive that does not exist. Eleven fields say his passive 'blocks' or 'absorbs' your first auto-attack - whys[0], whys[2], whys[3], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[2], the early, mid and late prose, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[1]. The late paragraph goes further and states a mechanic outright: 'his passive block requires five auto-attacks to recharge'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Mortal Will is one sentence: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' There is no block, no absorb and no five-attack recharge anywhere in it. This is the old pre-rework passive, inherited into the page and then reasoned from as if it were live. Every plan built on 'wait for his block to be down' is a plan around nothing, and the player spends the lane watching a stack counter that has no defensive meaning.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will described as a spell empowerment throughout, and the real defensive tool named in its place.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault (E) is never mentioned in the content layer at all - not once across seven whys, four spikes, three prose blocks and six wants.
audit.why: It is the actual answer to a Riven combo and the actual thing she has to beat: 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear', 22/21/20/19/18s, flagged as a channel. Two consequences the page owes the reader. First, it blocks damage from the front - not crowd control - so Ki Burst's stun lands through it, and because it is a channel the stun cancels it outright. Second, spending Wind Slash or a full rotation into a set shield is throwing the combo away. The pantheon__riven mirror reached the same conclusion from the other side.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault named in whys[2], whys[5], whys[6], the 2-item spike, the early, mid and late prose and wants.you[0], with the stun-cancels-channel interaction stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon while the packet chart reads Pantheon six times then Riven - and the page's own whys agree with the packet, not with the tokens above them.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'he wins every Level 1 skirmish' on a row marked Skill. whys[3] says 'you are denied reliable trades' on a row marked Skill. whys[4] says he re-engages any disengage and nearly one-shots you, on a row marked Skill. whys[6] says in as many words 'Riven owns this and every fight from here' on a row marked Pantheon. Four of seven rows contradict the prose directly beneath them. The 55.15% win rate is not in conflict: Pantheon owns the lane and Riven owns the two-item game, which is exactly what the corrected chart says.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Riven, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Grand Starfall is described as a Level 6 spike with no sense of how often it comes back.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s at 5500 range - the longest cooldown in either kit by a distance, which is why 'track his R' is worth doing and why a spent Starfall opens a two-and-a-half-minute window rather than a moment. Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22 to 18s, Comet Spear 11 to 8s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into whys[3], whys[5], whys[6], the Level 2-3 spike, the mid prose, wants.you[0] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is never mentioned, so the page tells you to watch for a dash that is already too late to react to.
audit.why: Shield Vault carries the autoReset flag: he dashes, stuns, and his next attack fires immediately. The readable tell is the attack wind-up on landing, not the cast.

edits.before: Pantheon owns this lane at Level 1 — his empowered Q spear poke is longer range than anything in your kit and his passive block eats your first auto in every attempted trade, so don't walk up to fight him bare. Level 2 is his spike: W point-click stun into empowered Q is a full-trade combo you cannot interrupt once it starts, and your E shield does not come out fast enough to block the stun proc. Play at max Q range to last-hit and only walk up when his W is visibly on cooldown — he has no way to stun you without it. At Level 3 his passive is still up constantly from the Q poke, so your ideal window is baiting him to use it on a minion, then dashing in with E the instant it goes on cooldown, landing W stun before he can proc it on your first auto.
edits.after: Pantheon owns this lane at Level 1 — Comet Spear throws 575 units against the 275 of anything in your kit, and Mortal Will empowers it every few casts, so do not walk up to fight him bare. Level 2 is his spike: Shield Vault is a point-click stun into empowered Comet Spear, and Valor's shield does not come out fast enough to stop the stun landing. Play at max Broken Wings range to last-hit and step up only when Shield Vault is visibly down — it is his only stun. At Level 3, if he sets Aegis Assault, do not pour your combo into the front of it; he is invulnerable to damage from that arc. Ki Burst is the answer: the stun lands through it and cancels the channel outright, and 18 to 22 seconds pass before he has it back.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain his — he bullies you off the wave with empowered Q every time his passive is stacked, and your cooldowns are too long to consistently out-trade his poke-into-stun pattern. Accept farming under tower if you have to; dying is infinitely worse than losing CS. At Level 6 he gets Grand Starfall: he can drop on you from distance when you try to disengage a bad trade, so always track his R bar. Your own R comes online here but his passive block still stops your first auto in the execute window — use Wind Slash early in the combo rather than saving it for last, because his block will eat the auto you would have weaved in beforehand.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 remain his — he bullies you off the wave with an empowered Comet Spear whenever Mortal Will is charged, and your cooldowns are too long to out-trade poke-into-stun. Accept farming under tower if you have to; dying is worse than losing CS. At Level 6 he gets Grand Starfall, 5500 units on a 180-second cooldown, so he lands on you the moment you walk away from a bad trade — track it like a second Flash. Your own R arrives here too, but never fire Wind Slash into a set Aegis Assault: he is invulnerable to frontal damage. Break the channel with Ki Burst first, then execute.

edits.before: This is your lane. Pantheon's damage stops scaling the moment you reach two completed items — his passive block requires five auto-attacks to recharge and your Q chain triggers all five in seconds, meaning every extended fight drains his block and leaves him a sitting target for your full rotation. He has no sustain and no mobility to kite you, so once your kit's burst is on par with his poke damage he simply cannot win a prolonged all-in. Force side-lane duels on your terms, never walk into a Grand Starfall re-engage, and let your superior scaling close what was a brutal early lane.
edits.after: This is your lane. Pantheon's damage stops scaling the moment you reach two completed items, and his one defensive tool is a channel: Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, but Ki Burst stuns through it and cancels it outright, so every fight he tries to stall out ends early instead. He has no sustain and no mobility beyond a 150-second ultimate, so once your burst matches his poke he cannot win a prolonged all-in. Force side-lane duels on your terms, never stand where a Grand Starfall lands behind you, and let your scaling close a brutal early lane.

notes: This is the worst matchup I found in the slice. Eleven fields were reasoning from Pantheon's PRE-REWORK passive, including a hard mechanical claim ('his passive block requires five auto-attacks to recharge') that Riot's current text does not support in any part - Mortal Will only empowers his next spell. The page then built its whole plan on waiting for a block that does not exist, while never once naming Aegis Assault, which is the ability that actually blocks. Worth grepping every owner's Pantheon entry for 'passive block' and 'absorbs your first auto' - this reads like a reused generated phrase, exactly like the Nasus and Riven cases elsewhere in this slice.
